findings.message: 6 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "数字媒体技术 CREATIVE DEVELOPER" above "程子悦."; "项目与经历" above "从想法，到可体验。"; "UNITY · 策略塔防" above "Tower Defense 烽誓 · 守望"; "UNITY · 第一人称射击" above "far cry Ash Exodus"; "UNITY · 第一人称射击" above "Csol far Cs Oline Monster"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: 9 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): button.text-action 240px | button.text-action 240px | div.category-tabs 1282px | button.text-action 280px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.
Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.
Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The h1 is a bare name ("程子悦.") and nothing else on the first screen says what this is.
findings.fix: Keep the name if it leads, and give the line under it (18px or more) the plain words: what it is, for whom, where or when. In the study of 97 Sites of the Day, first screens that named nothing lost usability and content points.

findings.message: Pinned large text slides across pictures while the page scrolls: "连接逻辑，" (screen 3, 100% over a picture); "交互与想象。" (screen 3, 100% over a picture); "让想法， 有自己的节奏。" (screen 6, 100% over a picture)
findings.fix: Jurors read a pinned title crossing drawings or photographs as a collision. Keep the pictures in the column the title does not occupy, or unpin it.

findings.message: Only 0 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
findings.fix: Build the motion layer (SKILL.md step 9, references/motion.md): the signature move, an entrance for the parts of every section, feedback on every control, and one moving picture. Transform and opacity only, with a reduced-motion fallback.

findings.message: 7 of 11 desktop screens are almost empty ground (under 20% of the screen holds text, a picture or a colour field): screens 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7.
findings.fix: An empty screen is a rest only once per page. Elsewhere it means the section is underbuilt: set its content larger, give it the full information, put it on a colour field, or cut it.
